sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published by Exophase (GTA VI PSN trophies) and PSNProfiles (GTA VI trophy list), which agree on every entry. Guides below are written for this tracker from those official descriptions; each trophy names its sources.

trophies.guide: The platinum: it unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing separate to do for it. Work the roadmap in order — story spine first, missable mission trophies as they appear, then the collectibles and activities cleanup — and this one lands last. It cannot be missed as long as every other trophy is still obtainable, which is why the missable flags in this tracker matter.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list
